label: Experimental entropy-coder court on real public weight planes. Not a wire-format decision; no mode was added or changed.

corpus.note: Every file in the manifest was re-hashed in the court before the run. The court uses Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, and pythia-70m step0/step1; the remaining files are verified but not measured.

method: All plane inputs are extracted through the shipped mode encoders (modes 9/11/12/15). Each coder encodes each plane independently; encoded_bytes sums the streams and charges the serialised Tunstall dictionary (per-plane: one per plane, per-tensor: one per tensor, family-shared: one per declared family, with encoded_bytes_amortized dividing that dictionary by the number of family members). Encode MiB/s uses the median of encode repetitions; decode MiB/s uses the p50 of decode repetitions. p99 is the observed percentile of the decode sample set. The pooled summary sums per-row medians weighted by decoded bytes; it is not one pooled timing run. The process peak RSS is the kernel high-water mark reset immediately before each row; the six input classes stay resident, so small-region rows report a floor set by resident inputs. All numbers are from this court run, single host, warm cache.
tunstall_dictionary_rule: Alphabet = all 256 bytes; one-byte phrases start with the observed probabilities. Repeatedly split the highest-probability phrase (ties: phrase bytes ascending, insertion index ascending) into its 256 one-byte extensions; each split adds 255 entries. Stop when the next split would exceed 2^k or the serialised dictionary would exceed 1 MiB. A greedy longest match can fail only at the final suffix; that suffix is carried literally in an explicit tail section. Codewords >= dictionary length and non-zero padding bits are rejected.

summary.peak_rss_method: VmHWM reset immediately before each row; the six input classes' extracted planes stay resident, so small-region rows report a floor set by resident inputs

persistent_formats.note: This court adds an experimental module and its harness only. It defines no mode, changes no table, and writes no WFT1 frame. The cross-language gate and both conformance replays are run separately at the same code revision and cited here when supplied.

residual_risks: Single host, warm page cache; no fleet or cold-cache claim.
The court measures codec-level plane streams, not a shipped frame or store planner.
Tunstall's 256-byte alphabet means each split consumes 255 codewords; k=8 cannot split at all and k=12 fits only 15 splits.
The family-shared dictionary is built from a declared family (all tensors of the checkpoint pair where the mode applies, or 8 KV pages); its amortised cost is reported next to its full cost.
The rANS encoder uses integer division per symbol and was not micro-optimised; its throughput is a real property of this implementation, not a bound on rANS.
The process peak RSS of a small-region row includes the resident extracted planes of all six input classes.
No zstd dictionary or long-window mode is tested; levels 3 and 19 only.
